jtbd.jtbd_title: Repair teacher relationship & secure strong LoRs
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Diagnose conflict drivers; design apology + repair plan; map proactive value actions to earn credible letters.

interactions.user_ask: How do I repair a strained teacher relationship before rec letters are due?
interactions.jenny_reply: Acknowledge the miss, make a specific amends, and offer concrete help that saves them time next week.
Escalate to a short in-person check-in; bring a 2‑line update and a simple 10‑minute help offer.

interactions.user_ask: How do I ask for the letter after repairing?
interactions.jenny_reply: Ask only after two positive micro‑touches; include a draft brag sheet + deadlines and your theme.

outcomes.name: lor_repair_plan_v1
outcomes.details: Apology script + 3 value actions; weekly check‑ins added.
